parameters.name: AppId
parameters.description:
The application ID.

>  The ID can be up to 64 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: CustomSei
parameters.description:
The custom SEI.

>  The value is a JSON string that can be up to 4,096 characters in length.

parameters.name: TaskId
parameters.description:
The task ID.

>  The ID can be up to 55 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live set-live-mpu-task-sei --app-id yourAppId --task-id yourTaskId --custom-sei key_:_value --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live SetLiveMpuTaskSei --region cn-hangzhou --TaskId yourTaskId --AppId yourAppId --CustomSei 'key_:_value'
